acceptanceCriteria: A retained real-suspend run on macOS and a Linux run show gaps recorded once and no cap or reap firing.
A test covers the lease-keeper idle check across a gap.
Store-side reap on another agent's claim after wake is either gap-aware with a test or documented as a limit.
body: V1-1597 was tested with an injectable clock on macOS only. Not covered: Linux, a real suspend, a dedicated lease-keeper idle-check test, store-side reaping of a sleeping worker's expired lease during another agent's claim on wake, and recovery-retry backoff timing after a refused hand-off.
title: Qualify host-sleep handling on Linux and a real suspend; cover other lease-reap paths on wake (V1-1597 residual)
